messages:
dina: Quick doc bug: API ref for POST /v1/generate shows `max_tokens` and response using `choices[0].text`. Live service returns `max_new_tokens` and `output: [{text,...}]`. Breaking our examples and some quickstarts.

omar: Oof. Which files are out of sync?

dina: content/api/generate.md and the snippet source at site/_snippets/generate_examples.yaml. I repro with staging: response has output array.

kelly: Plan: (1) update param table to use `max_new_tokens`, (2) swap examples to `output` array shape, (3) regen snippets, (4) add a short migration note mapping `max_tokens` -> `max_new_tokens`, (5) add an example-validation test.

docs-bot: docs-ci: example-validation failed for content/api/generate.md (schema mismatch). Link: https://ci.internal.redwood/2001 :x:

omar: I'll open a PR with the changes and ping for review.

dina: Also add a tiny integration example showing server accepts both keys to reassure customers.

kelly: Sounds good. After merge someone should post a short blurb in #support.

omar: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1301
